founderAuthorization.rule: Add '.ai/cache/' to the skip list of validate-tr-comments.mjs. The folder is a gitignored, machine-local cache (npm cache + Electron binary), in the same class as node_modules/ and .ai/runtime/. Checking of source files does not change. A regression test is added.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.

finding.observed: After scripts/provision-electron.mjs places Electron under .ai/cache/electron, protected scripts/validate-tr-comments.mjs scans that gitignored cache and fails on Electron's LICENSES.chromium.html and vk_swiftshader_icd.json. scripts/bootstrap.ps1 runs canonical validation in the control repo, so a second scripts/install.ps1 run would fail.
finding.discoveredDuring: V6-PKG-E cycle-2 remediation validation with the Electron cache present
finding.otherValidatorsWithCachePresent: All other canonical validation steps passed with the cache present; only the tr step failed.

validationEnvironment.measuredBy: scripts/preflight.mjs on this machine; re-measured and required to match before each isolated validation run

implementation.validator: The skip list gains '.ai/cache/' after '.ai/runtime/'; the extension set, the lockfile exemptions and the 60-line //TR rule are unchanged.
implementation.gitignore: .gitignore already lists .ai/cache/ and validate-mechanical-closure.mjs enforces it.
implementation.tests: tests/pkg-e2-tr-scan.test.ts runs the real validator in temporary trees: cache files are ignored, a source JSON without //TR still fails, other .ai state files outside the cache are still scanned.
